nodes.name: Quote Webhook

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ pickup_address: $json.body.pickup_address, dropoff_address: $json.body.dropoff_address, weight_kg: $json.body.weight_kg, date: $json.body.date || '', time: $json.body.time || '' }) }}

nodes.name: Get Quote
nodes.notes:
Calls the FastAPI pricing engine.

IF N8N RUNS IN DOCKER, change localhost to host.docker.internal
otherwise the container will look for the API inside itself.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ action: $json.action || 'error', quote_gbp: $json.quote_gbp || null, distance_miles: $json.distance_miles || null, message: $json.message || 'Sorry, we could not price that job just now.' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond With Quote
nodes.notes:
action is one of: quote | redirect (over 790 kg) | error.
The fallback message means the caller always hears something sensible,
even if the pricing engine is unreachable.
